definitions.explanation: Steady and constant progress or development; advancing day by day and month by month.

examples.japanese: {科学技術|かがくぎじゅつ}は{日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}で{進歩|しんぽ}している。
examples.english: Science and technology are advancing rapidly.

examples.japanese: AIの{分野|ぶんや}は{日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}だ。
examples.english: The field of AI is making rapid progress.

examples.japanese: {日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}の{時代|じだい}に{遅|おく}れないようにしたい。
examples.english: I want to keep up in this age of rapid progress.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}):
{日進|にっしん} (daily progress) + {月歩|げっぽ} (monthly advance)

COMPONENTS:
- {日|にち}: day, sun
- {進|しん}: advance, progress
- {月|げつ}: month, moon
- {歩|ほ}: step, walk

LITERAL MEANING:
"Advancing day by day, progressing month by month" - emphasizing continuous improvement.

USAGE PATTERNS:
・{日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}の{技術|ぎじゅつ} (rapidly advancing technology)
・{日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}で{発展|はってん}する (to develop rapidly)
・{日進月歩|にっしんげっぽ}の{世|よ}の{中|なか} (a rapidly changing world)

CONTEXT:
Commonly used when discussing technological development, medical advances, or any field experiencing rapid change.
